name: EduFind
tagline: Course recommendations by different metrics, plus a social space to discuss courses.

awards: Best Use of SFU Courses API

problem: Choosing courses is harder than it should be.
solution: A React and Express app on Supabase using the courses API and an LLM to recommend and compare courses, with social discussion.
demo_moment: Team-described: compare courses and read peers' comments.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of SFU Courses API” among 217 submissions.
The team credits its clean interactive UI.

lessons: Scope creep cost features; the polished core still won.
